nodes.title: TRELLIS.2 MLX Single Image — Geometry Only

widgets_values:
# RMBG-2.0 dependency

This workflow removes the background before reconstruction so TRELLIS.2 does not turn the backdrop into geometry.

1. Accept BRIA's gated non-commercial access terms and download the four required files from [briaai/RMBG-2.0](https://huggingface.co/briaai/RMBG-2.0).
2. Place `BiRefNet_config.py`, `birefnet.py`, `config.json`, and `model.safetensors` in `ComfyUI/models/RMBG/RMBG-2.0/`.
3. Restart ComfyUI after installing the files.

The workflow also embeds official download metadata on the RMBG node. ComfyUI may still require browser authentication because the repository is gated. CFP does not bundle or mirror these weights. Commercial use requires a separate agreement with BRIA.

The CFP Input Mask Quality Gate inspects RMBG alpha before inference. Its separate MASK input is intentionally unused here because RMBG mask polarity differs; the gate derives standard ComfyUI transparency semantics from the RGBA alpha channel.
nodes.title: RMBG-2.0 — Required Model Files

widgets_values:
# TRELLIS.2 MLX — SINGLE IMAGE TO PRINT-SCALE MESH

This is the integrated **single-image manufacturing lane**.

1. RMBG-2.0 isolates the subject.
2. The mask-quality gate blocks suspicious alpha before MLX inference.
3. TRELLIS.2 generates a geometry-only GLB.
4. The exact untouched GLB is previewed, reported, and saved before mutation.
5. Small disconnected floaters are filtered into a new artifact.
6. The exact sanitizer input is previewed and diagnosed.
7. Conservative topology sanitation creates another artifact.
8. The background-geometry guard blocks unsafe voxel filling.
9. A 1024-cell watertight voxel candidate is created and reviewed.
10. Conservative post-voxel polish runs without moving vertices.
11. A separate smooth-normal display candidate is previewed without moving geometry.
12. The unchanged manufacturing result is scaled to 250 mm and checked against a 0.4 mm nozzle / 0.2 mm layer.

**No stage overwrites the raw TRELLIS artifact.** The smooth-shading branch is display-only; manufacturing diagnostics and export continue from the unmodified polished geometry. The 1024 tier is allowed only while its estimated dense grid remains within the 512³ safety budget. Gates may stop execution. Override a gate only after visual review. Geometry refinement does not preserve learned textures. This workflow does not auto-approve a mesh for printing.
